name: @casepilot/casepilot-api
description: CasePilot REST API with NestJS and TypeORM

scripts.lint: pnpm build:contracts && eslint src test tools eslint.config.mjs dependency-cruiser.config.mjs --max-warnings 0
scripts.check:dependencies: pnpm build:contracts && depcruise --config dependency-cruiser.config.mjs --output-type err-long src
scripts.check:architecture: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm check:dependencies && pnpm check:structure
scripts.test:architecture: pnpm build:contracts && tsx --test test/architecture/dependencies.test.ts test/architecture/eslint.test.ts test/architecture/structure.test.ts test/architecture/application-operations.test.ts test/architecture/data-access.test.ts
scripts.test: pnpm build:contracts && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test build/test/test/unit/configuration.test.js build/test/test/unit/health.test.js build/test/test/unit/error-handling.test.js build/test/test/unit/auth.test.js build/test/test/unit/crud.test.js && pnpm test:architecture
scripts.test:integration: pnpm build:contracts && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node build/test/test/run-integration-tests.mjs
